units.source_text: 首句以常不离身的玉梳盒比拟玉鬘。

en.t: The opening line compares Tamakazura to a jeweled comb box that is always kept close at hand.

units.source_text: 第二、三句言无论外孙女或孙女，总是我的孙儿。

en.t: The second and third lines say that whether she is a daughter's child or a son's child, she is still my grandchild.

units.source_text: 日文中有三处双关：“两”与“盖”同音；

en.t: There are three puns in the Japanese: two and lid have the same sound;

units.source_text: “亲孙子”与“套盒”（即双重套合之盒）同音；

en.t: true grandchild and nested box, that is, a box made of two fitted layers, also sound alike;

units.source_text: “身”与“盒身”同音，都关联到玉梳盒。

en.t: body and the body of the box also sound alike, and all of them are connected with the jeweled comb box.

units.source_text: 所以下文中源氏说：“三十一个字母之中，和玉梳盒无关的很少。”

en.t: That is why Genji says later, Of the thirty-one syllables, very few have nothing to do with the jeweled comb box.

units.source_text: 日本短歌限用三十一个字母。

en.t: A Japanese tanka is limited to thirty-one syllables.
